scope: Actual Three Object3D add/remove events, createBiomeWorlds material lifecycle and retention counters; actual grass geometry connectivity, active transforms and generated shader contracts. No renderer, browser, full DOM or GPU shader compilation is simulated.

checks.name: snow initialization leaves source materials and geometry untouched
entering meadow patches terrain, forest and a Mesh backdrop root once
a new direct LOD is painted synchronously before any next update or render
new nested groups and later deep children are watched immediately
removing direct and nested LODs restores source materials and drops retention records
forest and backdrop subtree additions use the same reversible lifecycle
returning to snow restores exact original references and defers new seasonal paint
active near and middle grass have finite ranges and one stable seed per connected blade
grass fading discards complete stable blades without collapsing their geometry or writing outline depth
destroy restores originals and unbinds root and descendant lifecycle listeners
